description: Compare two Site Audit exports of the same page (before and after a fix): fixed, still present, new, and regressed (new in a category where something was fixed). Categories that did not run in both are listed and left out. Use it to verify a fix after the user re-runs the audit and exports again. Page-derived text is under `untrusted`.

after.description: The audit export from after the fix.

before.description: The audit export from before the fix.

name: compare_audits
